root_idea.summary: The root centers on being cast down or falling headlong into a ruinous state.
root_idea.development: From the basic image of casting down, the attested branches extend to stumbling and falling, perishing, removal, degradation, and causative ruin; the verbal noun can express an imprecation of such a downfall.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized verbal-noun citation form.

senses.definition: A downfall after stumbling from which one does not recover; a ruinous fall.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic imprecatory construction فَتَعْسًا لَهُمْ, the noun evokes falling into a state of irreversible abasement or ruin.

senses.definition: Destruction or perishing invoked as an imprecation: ruin befall them.
senses.usage_conditions: The accusative verbal noun in فَتَعْسًا لَهُمْ functions as an imprecation and may be rendered as ruin, destruction, or perishing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To stumble and fall, including falling forward or upon the face; more generally, to fall.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The descriptions of falling upon the hands, mouth, or face are attested variants of the manner of falling, not obligatory restrictions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To miss one's proof in litigation or the object of one's search.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized usage attested in connection with disputation and seeking.
The verb may also occur in an imprecatory address wishing someone to perish.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become lowered or degraded; of fortune, to decline.
To cause someone to stumble and fall; hence to make him perish, become far removed, or be brought low.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative transitive construction, including expressions in which God is the agent; it can also describe causing fortune to decline.
A nominal meaning distinct from the verbal-noun sense of downfall or destruction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who stumbles or falls; تَاعِسٌ may also describe ill fortune.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Active-participial forms used intransitively and applied to a person; the fortune application is specifically associated with تَاعِسٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cause of stumbling and falling; figuratively, a cause of ill luck.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun naming an occasion, affair, or circumstance that brings about such a fall or misfortune.

cautions: The Lane Quran citation uses historical notation and is not converted into a modern 47:9 location; the displayed occurrence at 47:8:3 is independently supplied by QAC.
The Quranic imprecation is lexically interpretable as either a ruinous downfall or destruction/perishing, accounting for variation among translations.
